windowRestore.reason: Excluded from this scope: earlier Preview 4/5 low-level restore probes produced tiny viewports. This build's manual taskbar/minimize/restore remains unverified.

usageTiming.reason: Excluded from this scope: earlier full-suite timing was affected by desktop focus. This run verifies stored usage/pause persistence, not duration accuracy or minimize exclusion.

cardScope: Bundled provider logos decoded in packaged WebView2; options/Escape focus and upload/reset update cards and sidebar without launching. Browser tests separately verify custom-icon restart and narrow layouts.
nativeScope: Retained sessions and original document/input/URL/scroll/manually paused local media position, no reload/extra count on return, six-app capacity without eviction, explicit Close/process cleanup, sidebar/loading/navigation/security/fullscreen, stored usage/pause and restart persistence. Native foreground-duration/minimize-exclusion accuracy and low-level restore are excluded.
mediaScope: Parking uses native SetIsMuted and IsMuted read-back, hides the view, then requests best-effort TrySuspend. Returning restores pre-parking mute intent after reveal. The fixture is manually paused before switching; it does not establish provider auto-pause, background playback position or CPU/memory savings. No remote scripts are injected.
